# T4SKAG3NT 0.1.6 Model Setup Update
This update makes the AI model setup cleaner and more capable:
- Detects compatible local models already downloaded on the Mac. - Adds a focused local model library with a broader set of verified Hugging Face MLX models, filtered for this Mac's memory. - Offers small, balanced, and higher-capability model families from Qwen, Llama, Gemma, Phi, and Mistral where the hardware permits. - Replaces inline cloud credentials with a guided provider registration window. - Verifies OpenAI and Anthropic API keys directly with the provider before registration. - Loads the supported models available to the registered account and allows one or more to be selected. - Stores provider keys securely in Apple Keychain and preserves compatibility with existing settings.

# T4SKAG3NT 0.1.5 Edge-to-Edge Artwork Update
This update refines the setup experience introduced in 0.1.4:
- Extends the luminous task artwork across the full width of the main setup view. - Applies the edge-to-edge artwork treatment consistently across every setup step. - Keeps headings, forms, cards, and safety information in a centered readable column. - Preserves the glass styling, centered navigation, and local-first setup behavior.

# T4SKAG3NT 0.1.4 Setup Experience Update
This release brings the polished first-run experience to the installed app:
- Adds a three-second branded launch screen with a luminous progress bar. - Enlarges and aligns the application identity in the setup sidebar. - Introduces the new “Welcome to your local task agent!” opening experience. - Adds glossy glass surfaces and larger, more readable onboarding content. - Carries the electric-blue, teal, and magenta visual language through every setup step. - Adds step-specific coordinator, model, safety, storage, and completion artwork. - Centers the primary setup action for a calmer, more consistent flow.
The underlying local-first privacy, approval, storage, model, and update safeguards remain unchanged.
